name: @buku/database
description: Database v2: the directory, user and business shards, the catalog, their schemas and migrations, and the data plane.

scripts.generate: prisma generate --config prisma.directory.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.user.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.business.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.catalog.config.ts
scripts.validate: prisma validate --config prisma.directory.config.ts && prisma validate --config prisma.user.config.ts && prisma validate --config prisma.business.config.ts && prisma validate --config prisma.catalog.config.ts
scripts.migrate:deploy: prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.directory.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.catalog.config.ts
